name: wow-addon
description: World of Warcraft addon development helpers — standard-compliant scaffolding, standards compliance auditing, standards-reference refreshing (re-syncing an addon's in-repo reference and the vendored quirks catalogue as the standard evolves upstream), LibKa0s re-vendoring (carrying the shared library's newest tagged payload into a consumer whole — both libs/LibKa0s/ and tests/_kit/ — rolling the CLAUDE.md provenance line in the same commit, reporting the per-file LibStub minor delta, then recommending, interviewing per candidate and implementing the new surfaces worth adopting, with declines filed as issues and a frozen docs/revendor/ bundle), cross-repo learning harvesting (promoting the collection's patterns, anti-patterns, client quirks and audit findings back into the standard), a six-command issue-* family over a GitHub-issue store keyed on state: and severity: labels — discovery and triage as separate commands, hand-filing, a plain listing, a per-issue detail view grouped by status and ordered most-severe-first, and a collection-wide summary (status × repo, severity × repo over the open backlog, and a status × severity crosstab) — interface-version bumping, doc sync (including the root DEPENDENCIES.md toolchain contract), version bumping with the release-time automated-test bundle, test-battery running, consolidated automated-test recording (lint/tests/perf/complexity into frozen dated bundles), in-game perf-run recording and analysis (the report and JSON dump the player copied out of the client, split, validated and written to a frozen docs/perf-analysis/ bundle with its write-up), execution-status reporting (what is done, running and left, percent complete and a pace-measured time to finish for everything the conversation planned — a single multi-step task or a subagent / dynamic-workflow run across repos — reading any documented plan ledger and reconciling it against git commits and live background work, read-only), git diff/commit, changeset finalization (sync-docs, commit, merge, push and branch cleanup — for the current repo or across sibling repos in dependency order), line-ending hook, and a focused WoW-specific review subagent that re-runs the out-of-game suites (lint, tests, offline perf scenarios, complexity) before it reviews.
